config.cohort_policy: all whole matches ready in Stage 04; reviews retained separately
config.prediction_timing: pre-event; no future appearances or allocations
config.quality_policy: Stage 03 prior-date smoothed metrics; separate dimensions; no centering
config.batting_policy: sum available never-entered batters only; exclude current pair and previously entered players
config.bowling_policy: sum Stage 04 remaining nominal balls / 6 times bowling quality; include current bowler
config.direct_quality_policy: exclude striker, non-striker and bowler direct quality and evidence
config.capacity_policy: individual upper bounds, not an allocated innings budget; no historical-use weights
config.zero_pool_policy: empty batting pool or zero eligible bowling capacities produce zero sums
